items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He came into the nightclub with Bobby Cranshaw. Quartet. John Bunch on piano and Ted Nash on saxophone.

ctx.x: Oh, Big Sid Catlett. He would take me – I remember going to Atlantic City to hear Benny Goodman’s band. Big Sid was playing with Benny. During one of the intermissions, Big Sid said, “Come here, kid.” He said, “Here’s how you play the hi-hat.” You’ve got to have a special touch for the hi-hat. “Here’s how you play the brushes.” That guy was a champ with the brushes, Jo Jones. He came into the nightclub with Bobby Cranshaw. Quartet. John Bunch on piano and Ted Nash on saxophone. Let me tell you. He came in with a…
It sounds like the drummers was a fraternity of sorts. It sounds like you guys had a real rapport and looked out for one another? Is that really the case?
